<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><title>Scoreboard</title></head>
<body style="margin:0">
<canvas id="scoreboard" width="400" height="100"></canvas>
<script>
// FLOOR-5 BASE, hand-written. playerA starts at 5 and the reset is already present. The decrement is absent.
const canvas = document.getElementById('scoreboard');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let playerA = 5;
let playerB = 0;
function updateScoreboard() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  ctx.font = '20px Arial';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.fillText('Player A: ' + playerA, 10, 20);
  ctx.fillText('Player B: ' + playerB, 290, 20);
}
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'z') {
                // FACT line 9: playerA is declared `let`.
                // FACT line 19: existing code writes it as if (e.key === 'a') { playerA++; updateScoreboard(); }
                // FACT line 10: playerB is declared `let`.
// on this key: playerA is one lower. Ensure playerA never goes below 5.
                playerA--;
                if (playerA < 5) playerA = 5;
                updateScoreboard();
            }
  if (e.key === 'a') { playerA++; updateScoreboard(); }
  else if (e.key === 'b') { playerB++; updateScoreboard(); }
  else if (e.key === '0') { playerA = 5; playerB = 0; updateScoreboard(); }
});

updateScoreboard();
window.app = { state: () => ({ playerA, playerB }) };
</script></body></html>
